title.zh-CN: 芝加哥马拉松 2027 Time Qualifier 男子资格标准（按年龄组）
title.en: Chicago Marathon 2027 Time Qualifier men's standards by age group

unit.zh-CN: 分钟（资格全马净成绩上限）

note.zh-CN: 芝加哥马拉松官方 2027 Time Qualifier 男子标准（女子/非二元标准在每个年龄组均更慢，如 16-34 为 3:20:00）；成绩须来自 USATF/WA 认证全马，窗口 2025-01-01 至 2026-10-29，半马或 50K 成绩不接受。达标即获保证名额资格，与抽签 Drawing 相互独立。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Official Chicago Marathon 2027 Time Qualifier men's standards; women's and non-binary standards are slower at each band (e.g. 3:20:00 at 16-34). Proof must be a USATF/WA-certified marathon run between 1 Jan 2025 and 29 Oct 2026; half-marathon or 50K times are not accepted. Meeting the standard earns a guaranteed entry, separate from the non-guaranteed Drawing. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 芝加哥马拉松：分段累计距离
title.en: Chicago Marathon: cumulative distance by segment

note.zh-CN: 累计距离按官方计时点（起点、每 5K、半程 13.1 英里、mile 20–25、mile 25.2 与终点）排列；五套官方材料均未发布累计爬升或下降，本图不读取爬升。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Cumulative distance follows the official checkpoints (start, every 5K, halfway 13.1 miles, miles 20–25, mile 25.2 and finish); none of the five official artefacts publishes cumulative ascent or descent, so this chart reads no climb figure. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.
